name: Warpriest's kit
body:
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 206
Price 16 gp; Weight 44 lbs.
Category Kits
Description
This kit includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, a cheap holy textUE, a flint and steel, an iron pot, a mess kit, rope, soap, a spell component pouch, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), a waterskin, and a wooden holy symbol.
